products.name: MuPDF

products.name: PDFgear
products.features: Reading, editing, annotation, OCR, conversion, GPT-powered assistant
products.claim: AI assistant says it can summarize dozens of pages in seconds; this is cloud/AI task time, not local parse speed

products.platforms: Windows, Linux (macOS listed as coming soon)

products.name: Okular
products.features: Multi-format reader, annotations, text selection, PDF signatures and validation

products.name: PDF24 Reader

products.name: Nitro PDF Pro
products.features: Reading, OCR, editing, signatures, conversion; recent releases mention large/complex PDFs

products.name: Xodo PDF Reader
products.features: View, search, annotate, forms, digital signatures, layers, storage integrations

products.name: sioyek
products.features: Research-oriented navigation, generated/searchable TOC, smart jumps, portals, bookmarks, SyncTeX

products.name: Sejda PDF Desktop
products.features: Local/offline PDF editing, conversion, forms, annotation, OCR (daily limits in free tier)

products.name: Adobe Acrobat Reader
products.features: Reading, accessibility/reflow, forms, signatures, browser Fast Web View

products.name: Microsoft Edge PDF reader
